points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable clean build fails main.cpp:39 undeclared run_solver; CMake config succeeds. Historical executable source binding is unavailable.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:37–64 recognizes solve and required paths, but returns success for missing command and silently ignores unknown options; clean executable does not build.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: CGNS, geometry, gas and solver modules are separated; main solver is monolithic and serial-only.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal existing-solver invocation found; external authorship investigation excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: case_reader.cpp consumes JSON mesh and physics inputs; no two-filename-only solver branches found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:90–100 reads and solves on rank zero only; no METIS graph partition, halo exchange or distributed reduction implementation.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: VTK writer hardcodes identical cell connectivity, positive-state failure resets to freestream, no parallel robustness; global serial geometry does compute volumes.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: No reproducible rank comparison or independent tests established; report validator lacks Re200 wake figure. Clean build failed before tests.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Modules are legible but final source does not compile, local geometry and final VTK contain placeholders, metadata scripts assert unsupported status.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Perfect-gas conservative state and nondimensional inputs exist; results suffer first-order and inaccurate viscous approximations.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: cgns_reader.cpp first zone handles TRI_3/QUAD_4 and boundary edges; face_geometry.cpp computes global Green-theorem volumes; multi-zone unsupported and local geometry is placeholder.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: fvm_solver.cpp:99–159 applies equal/opposite interior flux and boundary flux, but first-order states and limited validation restrict credit.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: fvm_solver.cpp:175–212 implements local Lax-Friedrichs/Rusanov; entropy treatment is its diffusive form.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: farfield, reflected slip and negated-velocity no-slip branches are present; simplified wall flux limits accuracy.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: fvm_solver.cpp:109–114 uses cell averages directly; report discloses first-order-only.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: No reconstruction limiter; nonpositive updated cells are reset to freestream rather than reconstructed-state positivity preservation.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: fvm_solver.cpp:215–256 omits cell distance in gradients; :513–521 approximates shear as mu times speed without wall distance/sign.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: CFL-ramped local diagonal updates exist, but inner iterations reuse a frozen residual and no coupled linear convergence is shown.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solve dispatches steady solve; report admits BDF2 pending, and Re200 rows after step 7124 were copied without solving.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS is linked but no partition call, rank-local distributed solve, halo or global reduction is implemented.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Required final fields contain placeholder connectivity, logs absent, and Re200 metadata falsely claims BDF2; serial histories are separately supported.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Historical case checks passed structurally, but report validator lacked Re200 wake; this does not verify field correctness.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Seven steady serial solves have logs; M0.15 inviscid lacks target and stable forces, and Re200 has no transient while metadata claims periodicity.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 CD 4.984 is excessive and M0.15 inviscid unstable; remaining steady values finite but first-order/viscous and binary provenance limit accuracy.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: PDF shows force/residual histories but its Mach/pressure contour captions depict surface-point scatter; no laminar gallery or Re200 wake.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report candidly discloses serial, first-order and Re200 steady status, but claims absent METIS infrastructure and presents surface scatter as domain contours.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Manifest wrongly cites field_final.vtk for surface-point plots; isolated submitted-surface fallback reconstruction has matching layout and range but differs by three pixels in width. Exact pixel identity is unproven; no unrelated data source is established.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean immutable-source build fails on undeclared run_solver at main.cpp:39. CLI parser exists but ignores unknown options; final VTK connectivity is placeholder and logs are missing.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: cgns_reader.cpp:23–56,117–150 reads first zone, triangle/quad sections and boundary edges; face_geometry.cpp:31–75 orients normals and computes global Green-theorem volumes. Multi-zone and local placeholder remain limitations.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: fvm_solver.cpp:99–159 assembles paired conservative interior fluxes and boundary residual; Rusanov and mirrored wall states exist. First order, geometry/viscous simplifications and no verified production-source binding limit credit.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: fvm_solver.cpp:109–114 uses piecewise constant states; no reconstruction/limiter or smooth-order evidence. Report.tex:78,233 honestly discloses first order.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: fvm_solver.cpp:215–256 uses case-Re viscosity but differences omit distance and use simplified stresses; :513–521 approximates tangential force as mu times speed without wall distance/sign fidelity.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: fvm_solver.cpp:362–372 ramps CFL but caps at 20; :404–428 repeats a frozen residual in local diagonal updates. There is no BDF2 transient or measured inner convergence.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: main.cpp:90–100 solves only on rank zero; METIS, halo and reductions are absent, no rank comparison.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Selected-session logs support seven steady solves but M0.15 inviscid has no stable plateau, Re20 drag 4.984 is implausible, Re200 is steady and final VTK connectivity is placeholder. No rank comparisons.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Report has equations and honest limitations, but no laminar gallery/domain contours, incorrect contour/manifest claims and false METIS infrastructure; traceability is limited.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Case JSON and modules separate mesh, gas and solver but source is 2-D and equation/BC logic is tightly coupled; no functioning distributed or generic physics interfaces.

flags.text: Figures do not correspond to results
flags.evidence: e272cd3 report.tex:271–279 embeds M0.15 Mach/pressure figures captioned as contours; their images explicitly say surface data. figure_manifest.csv calls their source field_final.vtk, but plot_results.py:470–483,527–538 shows a surface.csv fallback with fixed field manifest. An isolated fallback render from the submitted surface.csv reproduces the plot layout and color range but differs in width by three pixels (561×1020 vs 561×1023), so exact original byte provenance is unproven. Surface CSV is itself a submitted output; the wrong field/contour claim and manifest are penalized, but DQ8 does not follow without proving the embedded figure does not correspond to any submitted field/CSV output.

flags.text: Claimed METIS but geometric split or full-state replication
flags.evidence: Metadata claims METIS, but e272cd3:solver/src/main.cpp:90–100 reads and solves the entire mesh on rank zero only. Other ranks do not replicate the full state, and no geometric split is shown. Serial-only implementation is deficient and unsupported METIS credit is zero, but the specific trigger wording requires geometric split or full-state replication.
Metadata accurately identifies first_order; no report claim of active second-order production reconstruction was found.
Metadata documents cell_center semantics; no separate failed surface check established.
No direct internal evidence; trust policy forbids external-copy investigation.
